message.content: {"note_claim": "ICE has not been deployed to MSP airport, even though ICE agents are assisting TSA at some other airports with long wait times during the partial government shutdown.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Though Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents have been spotted at airports across the country Monday as the Transportation Security Administration faces staffing shortages, Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport is still operating without them.", "reason": "The page directly states ICE agents are at other airports during the TSA shortage while MSP operates without them, and that MSP wait times have stayed under 30 minutes."}

parsed.note_claim: ICE has not been deployed to MSP airport, even though ICE agents are assisting TSA at some other airports with long wait times during the partial government shutdown.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Though Immigration and Customs Enforcement agents have been spotted at airports across the country Monday as the Transportation Security Administration faces staffing shortages, Minneapolis-St. Paul International Airport is still operating without them.
